name: Rubin Observatory LSST (reference design) with the LSST camera
note: The reference design of the 2019 paper. Gain and dark current are not stated there and are absent; the read noise is an assumption the paper states for its depth calculation.

pixelSize.n: CCD science sensors with 10 um pixels

readNoise.n: assumed instrumental noise of 9 e- per pixel and per readout, in the paper

readoutTime.n: the longest acceptable read-out time, a design limit

exposureTime.n: a 30 s visit is two 15 s exposures

throughputConstant.n: the band-dependent parameter C_m of Eq. III.2.1

depth5sigma.n: typical 5-sigma point-source depth at zenith for 2 x 15 s exposures, AB

seeing.n: the footnote read says delivered median zenith seeing (FWHM); the depth formula reproduces the depths with this row (oracle o4) while the paper's text says the effective seeing enters it, so the labels of the two seeing rows may be exchanged in the text read; the neighbouring row (0.81 to 0.68 arcsec) is not stored
